design: Reconstruction from the supplied Revision 4 seed list plus targeted primary-source retrieval
selection: The 17 systems named in the manuscript are retained. This package does not silently expand the manuscript corpus.
operations: Read the supplied manuscript and recover its study IDs, task distinctions and four contrasts.
Retrieve exact-title primary-source records, linked arXiv manuscripts and official proceedings.
Inspect method/action interfaces and endpoint-specific experimental sections; freeze versions in sources.json.
Split source-task/input variants without counting variants as independent studies.
Transcribe four within-study contrasts with explicit source cells and experimental boundaries.
Generate S1 from the JSON register and execute deterministic arithmetic and boundary-case checks.
query_families: Exact system/paper title + official proceedings or site:arxiv.org
Exact title + planning / action history / frozen encoder
Within-source terms: future ego poses, actor behavior, validity mask, selector, Table 3, Table 4, Table 11
exclusions: General robotics, static perception and datasets are context rather than core systems; ACT-Bench and WorldLens are comparators.
scope_note: This log describes present reconstruction work. It does not recreate an unobserved historical search or claim systematic coverage.
access_note: Some CVF direct PDF requests returned 403. Linked arXiv full texts were used with explicit versions; numerical official tables were also checked during this chat.
limitations: Single AI-assisted extraction; no independent second coder.
No new neural-model training, driving rollouts or road trials.
Missing experimental-quality fields mean not extracted, not absent in the source.
D/P/X/NR codes are interpretations of specified claims, not author-independent certifications.
